units.after_edits: 11.8 Notices. Any notice, request, consent, approval, or other communication required or permitted under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered by hand, by reputable pre-paid overnight courier service, or by email with delivery confirmation to the address of the relevant Party set out at the beginning of this Agreement. Notices shall be deemed delivered: (a) upon actual receipt if delivered by hand; (b) two (2) Business Days following deposit with an international overnight courier service; or (c) on the date of transmission if sent by email during regular business hours on a Business Day, with no notification of delivery failure received.

units.raw: 11.9 Counterparts and Electronic Execution. This Agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original, but all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument. Execution and transmission of this Agreement by exchange of electronic signatures (including DocuSign or Adobe Sign) or signed PDF files via email shall have the same legal force and binding effect as physical execution and delivery of paper originals.

units.raw: 11.10 Governing Law and Dispute Resolution. This Agreement and any dispute, controversy, proceedings, or claim of whatever nature (including non-contractual disputes or claims) arising out of or in connection with it or its subject matter or formation shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England and Wales. Each Party irrevocably submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales to resolve any dispute, controversy, or claim arising under, out of, or in connection with this Agreement.
